name: CashBunny
title: Cash Bunny - Redeem Code App
description: Play, complete tasks, and earn coins for fun and rewards! Complete missions, collect coins, and unlock supported payout options inside a polished gaming reward experience.
featuresDescription: Every earning route is presented as a mission path, so users can scan tasks, understand progress, and return for fresh activities.

features.title: Game Missions
features.description: Jump into casual games and complete eligible playtime milestones when they are available.

features.title: Hot Offers
features.description: Pick limited-time offers, app trials, surveys, and partner tasks with clear reward tracking.

features.title: Daily Rewards
features.description: Use check-ins, streaks, and activity bonuses to keep your coin progress moving.

features.title: Referral Ladder
features.description: Invite friends and unlock referral bonuses after valid activity conditions are completed.

steps.title: Choose Mission
steps.description: Open the app and pick games, offers, surveys, referrals, or daily bonuses that match your region.

steps.title: Finish Action
steps.description: Complete the required steps and let the app or partner network validate eligible progress.

steps.title: Collect Coins
steps.description: Approved rewards move into the wallet with a transparent activity trail for the user.

steps.title: Redeem
steps.description: Request supported rewards once the payout requirement and verification rules are satisfied.
